rule: C-36 Plumbing Contractor is the CSLB classification covering plumbing systems; all ten licensees on this site hold it.
applies: The concealed waste-and-overflow assembly is plumbing work.

rule: C-9 Drywall Contractor is the CSLB classification covering drywall; none of the ten licensees holds C-9. A Class B General Building Contractor may contract for work involving at least two unrelated trades or crafts other than framing/carpentry, or hold/subcontract the specialty licence (BPC § 7057).
applies: The ceiling opening and restoration under the storage unit.

rule: BPC § 7048 exempts work whose aggregate contract price for labour, materials and all other items is under $1,000 (as amended by AB 1170, effective 2026-01-01), but the exemption does not apply where a building permit is required or where the person employs others.
applies: Context only — the requester asked for a licensed provider regardless of price.

rule: SF.gov: apply for a plumbing permit before cutting into or replacing pipes behind walls; exemptions are listed in SF Plumbing Code § 104.2. Licence classes accepted for plumbing permits: A; B (subject to conditions such as an approved scope or a linked kitchen/bath permit); C-4; C-36; C-16; C-20; C-54. DBI Help Desk 628-652-4900.
applies: Official reference for the concealed-pipe work described in the brief; applicability to a specific job is determined by the City, not by this site.

rule: SF.gov kitchen/bath remodel guidance: for R-2 apartment buildings the property owner may do drywall/sheetrock work but must hire licensed contractors for plumbing and electrical.
applies: Alternative split of the drywall and plumbing scopes if a single provider cannot be engaged.

rule: CIV § 1954: a landlord may enter to make necessary or agreed repairs; reasonable written notice stating date, approximate time and purpose (24 hours presumed reasonable), entry during normal business hours unless the tenant consents; landlord and tenant may agree orally to an entry for agreed repairs within one week; access must not be abused.
applies: The bathroom is tenant-occupied; the storage unit below may also require coordination.

rule: CSLB requires licensed contractors to carry a $25,000 contractor's bond; each record on this site shows the bond and surety.
applies: All ten records show a $25,000 bond on file.

rule: CSLB consumer guidance: confirm workers' compensation (and liability) insurance. A CSLB exemption means the licensee certified it has no employees.
applies: Four candidates are WC-exempt (Bay Area Plumbing, General SF, Rapid Flow, Manny's) — confirm who will physically perform the work.

rule: CSLB consumer guidance: a home-improvement down payment may not exceed 10% of the contract price or $1,000, whichever is less.
applies: Applies to the written contract with whichever provider is engaged.

rule: CSLB discloses certain citations and actions under B&P § 7124.6 via a link on the licence detail page.
applies: Handyman Heroes Inc (#1003394) shows Citation #2 2020 001045 dated 07/12/2020; no disclosure link was shown for the other nine records.
